name: extended-chase
description: The clean-buy chart and news (opening range 79.89-80.27, trend up, a light-volume pullback that holds VWAP), but from 10:44 ET the stock rips straight up to close at 81.40, 0.05 under the 81.45 session high. VWAP is about 80.47 and atr_5m 0.2294, so the close is about 4.05 five-minute ATRs above VWAP, well past the 2.0 extension threshold. Every plan's entry (last_close) is labelled extended, so plan_exit suggests only the minimum multiple. News is positive (analyst upgrade, supply contract, raised guidance), a material-agreement 8-K, no red flags.

expected.why: Same clean setup and catalysts as clean-buy, but buying at market chases a move about 4 five-minute ATRs above VWAP; every plan is labelled extended. Guards against the PASS-bias fix turning into always BUY.
